explanation: From main: swHandover.test.ts adds a regression test that registerUpdates() registers nothing and adds no listeners when VITE_SERVICE_WORKER is unset, because registering the self-destroying sw.js would reload every visit; compareLinks pins the Compare link codec and its in-app restore; compareTabToolbar checks the Compare summary starts folded with its row count, opens on request and reads one row per gene × population; compareTabContrast opens the folded summary before reading its cells. From this branch: statisticsPolicy.test.ts pins the significanceTier boundaries; searchPage.test.tsx covers nominal-only and mixed gene rows, nominal pathway rows ordered after FDR rows with their Call labels, and the no-p<0.05 fallback; geneReport.test.tsx covers nominal tracks listed after the FDR ones with their labels, uncoloured and uncounted, the nominal-only lead when nothing passes FDR, and its no-p<0.05 fixtures now raise raw p as well as q.
